title: Toward a record-eligible sub-2-hour marathon: an updated integrative framework of physiological, technological, and cognitive determinants
claims: VO2max, lactate threshold and running economy are physiological determinants commonly studied in distance-running performance.
Marathon performance is multi-factorial and includes physiological, technological and cognitive determinants.
Measurements depend on testing protocol and context, so values from different methods should not be treated as interchangeable.
